required_inputs: service list; source collection list; secrets list
verification_steps: Verify AWS/DocumentDB/Shopware/CDN/S3/Jira/Figma/Confluence access or approved deferral; verify each source collection is present and checksumed
pass_condition: Every required access/source item is ready or explicitly deferred with owner/scope impact

verification_steps: Decode/query all real source records; count rows; profile fields/types; measure joins; identify sparse fields/outliers/deletes/unapproved rows
pass_condition: All in-scope collections have measured counts/schema/join reports; no metadata-only estimates

required_inputs: source profile; Confluence plan; target constraints
verification_steps: For each business field, fill source paths, joins, transforms, validation, fixing, target payload, edge cases, owner, status
pass_condition: Zero unresolved blocker rows; all approved rows have owner and target path

verification_steps: Read target schema; verify custom fields/entities/plugins; write/read smoke records; compare dev/staging/prod drift
pass_condition: Every approved mapping target path is present and writable; schema drift resolved or approved

required_inputs: mapping contract; source profile; normalization harness
verification_steps: Generate target payloads; validate payloads; assign each source row a terminal local status; hash payloads
pass_condition: No UNKNOWN/unclassified rows; payload generation deterministic across reruns

required_inputs: batch manifest; Shopware dev; dry-run ledger
verification_steps: Run dependency-ordered batches; record target responses; read target back; compare counts/hashes/samples
pass_condition: Source ready count equals target load/read count; hashes and representative API samples pass

verification_steps: Repeat dev process in staging; compare with dev expectations and target reads
pass_condition: Staging reconciliation passes with no unexplained drift

required_inputs: staging-verified scripts; prod access; cutover window
verification_steps: Run prod load; reconcile; execute final delta; verify storefront/API/search samples
pass_condition: No unresolved critical failures; human approves cutover evidence

required_inputs: event contract; source/target access; sync processor
verification_steps: Test duplicate events; retries; DLQ replay; retention/outage recovery; daily reconciliation
pass_condition: Duplicate/replayed events converge; missed changes detected; DLQ replay works by source key
